leverage.exposure: The recommended move deliberately opens a leveraged position, and it has to be closed by hand before the lock — a negative balance when the matchday starts scores nothing for the entire matchday. The sequence is not flexible: bid Doan before his window shuts, and the moment he lands, sell Burger. If Scheller then also lands, sell Baum immediately — that branch is the dangerous one, because winning both bids without the second sale leaves the balance under water at the lock. If Doan is lost and only Scheller lands, Burger is still the sale and the balance ends comfortably clear. If neither lands, do nothing at all except fix the eleven, and keep Burger on the bench rather than selling him.

binding_gap: There is no formation hole to fix — the gap is qualitative and it is in midfield, created by Burger's rib knock rather than by any shortage of bodies. Doan fills exactly that hole: a confirmed starter in a probable XI published yesterday, in the one position where the squad is currently relying on a doubtful player and a weak reserve.

verdict.headline: Two things need doing before tonight's lock, and the first one is free.
verdict.headline_short: Two things need doing before tonight's lock, and the first one is free
verdict.detail: Two things need doing before tonight's lock, and the first one is free. The eleven is still set as a flat 4-4-2 with Baum on the bench, which is strictly worse than the 5-3-2 the ledger has been recommending since early this morning: dropping Tanaka for Baum gains points in every branch, whatever happens to Burger and whatever lands on the market. Apply it whether or not you do anything else today. The second is that the Doan offer was never actually placed. Scheller's was — it is live and resolves on its own at 14:27Z — but Doan sits on the board with no bid from us and the window shuts at 12:26Z. He is the piece that makes the rest work.

sell.reason: Burger is the sale, but only as the unwind leg of a buy and never on its own. Selling him unconditionally drops the squad to eleven and buys nothing, because benching him already captures the whole points case. Paired with Doan landing, the sale is close to costless on points and clears the deficit the bid opens. Baum is the second leg and fires only if Scheller also lands — and in that branch it is not optional, it is the thing standing between the squad and a zero-scoring matchday.

standing.name: Wouter Burger
standing.why: STRICTLY CONDITIONAL — FIRE ONLY ONCE A BUY HAS LANDED, AND NEVER ON ITS OWN. Unconditional sale drops the squad to ELEVEN, which kills the 5-4-1 shape that Whun06q identifies as the only hedge against Guirassy, and that hedge matters more today than it did yesterday (see this run's Guirassy WATCH). As the unwind leg of BUY Bs90r01 (Doan) or B0t8gwq (Scheller) the squad returns to TWELVE with the same 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT shape and the hedge survives intact. WHY HE IS THE RIGHT BODY TO SELL AND NOT TANAKA OR BAUM: (1) ZERO FIELDED COST. Wpzf62v's 5-3-2 fields three midfielders — Wolf 86, Petkov 94 and the weakest of the rest — so the fourth MID sits regardless. Burger is that fourth MID the moment Doan lands, and he is already the correct man to bench on fitness. (2) HE IS THE DOUBT, NOT THE ASSET. buli-tipphilfe's injury page, Datenstand 27.11.2026 03:00 Uhr for the 11. Spieltag, lists him in "TSG 1899 Hoffenheim muss zum naechsten Spieltag auf 6 Spieler verzichten: A. Hajdari, N. De Cat, O. Kabak, R. Hranac, V. Gendrey und W. Burger", with the table row "W. Burger | Verletzung (nicht naeher bezeichnet) | Fraglich" and NO expected return date. That is a THIRD dated source on top of RotoWire 26.11 (rib knock, severity unclear) and LigaInsider 26.11 23:37 (Angeschlagen), and it is the first one that moves him from "angeschlagen" to a club absentee list. Kickbase agrees: st 2, stl [2]. (3) HE IS THE LARGEST SINGLE UNWIND IN THE SQUAD at mv 19.293.450, which is what makes both buys affordable at once; the next largest free body is Baum at 5.474.706. (4) THE TICK WILL PRICE THE INJURY AND HE IS CARRIED AT A PRE-INJURY VALUATION. He is still flagged mvt 1, but his tfhmvt is +28.114 against a squad where every other mvt-1 body runs +46k to +257k — the momentum has already stalled, which is the market beginning to re-rate him. The next update is mvud 2026-11-27T21:00:00Z, i.e. 90 MINUTES AFTER the lock, so a sale fired any time today still pays exactly 19.293.450 with no tick risk; a sale deferred to tomorrow does not. The Bornauw precedent is explicit that an mvt-1 flag set before an injury predicts the tick DOWN, not up. SELLING BACK TO THE BOARD PAYS EXACTLY mv, measured across the whole log with no spread, so there is no auction risk on this leg. DO NOT sell him before a buy clears, and do not sell him at all if neither bid wins — in that branch the squad stays at 12, the 5-4-1 hedge stays available, and Burger is simply benched in 5-3-2 at zero cost.

standing.name: Elias Baum
standing.why: SECOND UNWIND LEG, AND IT FIRES ONLY IN THE BOTH-BUYS-LAND BRANCH. IF ONLY DOAN LANDS, DO NOT SELL BAUM: the Burger sale alone already clears the balance to +8.856.336 and Baum keeps his place as the fifth defender. IF ONLY SCHELLER LANDS, sell Burger and NOT Baum — Scheller displaces Baum in the eleven but Baum is then the twelfth body and the 5-4-1 hedge needs him on the bench, not sold. WHY HE IS THE RIGHT SECOND LEG RATHER THAN TANAKA: Scheller is a defender, so the defender he displaces is the sellable one, and selling Tanaka instead would leave six defenders and only three midfielders, which makes 5-4-1 illegal and destroys the Guirassy hedge for no gain. HE IS NOT BLOCKED ON MERIT AND NO LATER RUN MAY CITE THIS AS A FITNESS OBJECTION: Baum (7325) is an EINTRACHT FRANKFURT left-back — tid 4 is Frankfurt, not Stuttgart, see the identity correction in BUY Bs90r01 — Kickbase st 0 with stl [], and Comunio's 26.11.2026 probable XI for Stuttgart v Frankfurt on 28.11 names him in the starting eleven with Kosugi as the alternative: "Atubolu - Knauff, Koch, Brassier, Baum (Kosugi) - ...". CAVEAT TO CARRY FORWARD: his ph newest-first reads [did not play, 8, 86, 102, 17], so ap 64 is itself carried by two mid scores and his floor is low — which cuts both ways and is another reason the Scheller upgrade is real rather than cosmetic.

buy.reason: Doan first and urgently: confirmed in Frankfurt's probable eleven on a source published yesterday morning, fit, no absence against his name, and the only midfielder on the board who both upgrades the injured slot and resolves before the lock. Nothing else on the board is worth a bid. Katic and Seimen are genuine upgrades and were rejected purely on timing — both expire after the lock — and they deserve a fresh look tomorrow.
